howEyebrow: THREE STEPS TO YOUR FIRST STORY

steps.title: Connect your channel
steps.body: Type !creator in the game chat and open your private login link. Connect Twitch or YouTube to verify channel ownership. New channels require approval.

steps.title: Share RuinWatch gameplay
steps.body: For Twitch lives, use RuinWatch in your title and select Diablo III. For YouTube, submit a public video or live URL in the studio; submit live URLs before going live.

steps.title: Receive your Platinum
steps.body: The team reviews original gameplay minutes. Approved rewards are delivered when you enter the linked Normal or Hardcore mode, with the in-game Platinum animation.

rulesEyebrow: A FAIR STAGE FOR EVERY CREATOR
rulesIntro: The same program is open to every account. Channel ownership, eligible time and reward delivery are checked on the server.
rules: A shared limit of 4 hours per account each day covers Twitch lives, YouTube lives and videos. The allowance is reserved on approval and resets at 00:00 UTC.
Live rewards count observed eligible intervals only. Pauses, outages and time before monitoring do not count. Videos require manual review of eligible gameplay.
Reuploads, repeated footage, loops and a video of an already rewarded live do not earn a second payment. Simultaneous streams cannot be rewarded twice.
Only whole approved minutes count. Views, likes, follows and subscriptions have no influence on your reward.
You keep control of your channel. Disconnect it in the studio to revoke access and remove it from the showcase.
